text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up 1 Veridian renewal moving to procurement. Customer asked to shorten to 9 months from 12 and wants proration on final invoice. Can ops update SOW and run the calc?
Marco Diaz: Do we have a PO? Procurement usually blocks Docusign without PO/vendor code.
Evelyn Chen: They sent a tentative PO number PO-88219 but vendor code is missing. Procurement flagged that.
Samir Patel: Also seeing a billing-entity mismatch in onboarding notes. Legal needs to confirm signatory for amended term. Tagging @LegalBot.
LegalBot: Reminder: Term reductions require an exec-signed amendment + updated SOW to change billing terms.
Priya Rao: Ok. If finance accepts proration we can draft a one-page amendment. Suggested line item: "9mo pro-rated subscription" and the credit applied to final invoice.
Marco Diaz: Example proration calc for finance: Annual list $120,000 -> 9/12 = $90,000; credit $30,000 applied as final-invoice credit.
Evelyn Chen: That works. Procurement also wants payment terms; customer prefers Net60. Any objections?
Samir Patel: Net60 fine but billing and rev rec need to be alerted. I'll loop billing.
Priya Rao: Next blockers: vendor code and signature path. Marco, can procurement accept the PO without vendor code if the customer gives wire details?
Marco Diaz: Procurement's short answer: no. We can request an exception from the procurement lead (Maya). I'll ping her now.
Priya Rao: Evelyn, please draft the amendment + SOW patch with proration and Net60 note. Mark change reason: "term-shortening per customer request."
Evelyn Chen: Working on it. ETA ~2 hours. Will include Docusign envelope when ready.
Marco Diaz: Maya asked for the vendor code within 3 business days; she'll provision exception approval EOD if needed.
Priya Rao: Good. Samir, include a KMS clause appendix if customer manages keys; procurement asked earlier about HSM requirements.
Samir Patel: Noted. Also add an ops note capturing why term shortened: cause = "budget timing shift" for account health.
LegalBot: Amendment draft must include explicit billing-entity confirmation and signature block for both parties.
Evelyn Chen: Draft uploaded to our docs: https://redwood.app/drafts/veridian-9mo-amend-4998880001 (Docusign link to follow).
Marco Diaz: Procurement will provision vendor code tomorrow morning; exception approved for now.
Priya Rao: I'll mark thread status: awaiting vendor code + signature. Will ping sales if anything slips. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Adding billing to follow-up and logging note in account health board.
Evelyn Chen: Docusign envelope created and sent: https://docusign.example/envelope/4998880001
Priya Rao: Thanks team. Closing loop once signature and vendor code are in place.
